email.title: Verify your email
email.body: We'll send a verification link to {email}. Open the link in your inbox to confirm this address on your account. This is contact proof only, not an identity or safety check.
email.sent: Verification email sent. Check your inbox.
email.failed: Couldn't send the verification email. Try again shortly.

change.title: Change email
change.body: We'll email a link to your new address. {email} stays on your account until you open it, and we'll let that address know about the change.
change.sentBody: We sent a link to {email}. Your email changes once you open it.
change.failed: Couldn't start the email change. Try again.

phone.introAdd: Enter your contact phone number. We only confirm we can reach this number. It is not an identity, DBS, or safety check.
phone.introChange: Enter your new mobile number. Your current number stays on your account until you confirm the new one with the code we text you.
phone.ukOnly: UK mobile numbers only (+44). We'll text you a 6-digit code to confirm this number on your account.
phone.passwordHelp: Enter your Slashie password to confirm it's you. We'll also text your current number about the change.
phone.codeIntro: To verify this mobile number, enter the 6-digit code we sent to {phone}.
phone.codeHelp: Codes are valid for 10 minutes. Didn't receive one?
phone.invalidPhone: Enter a valid UK mobile number (+44).
phone.needCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your SMS.
phone.sendFailed: Couldn't send the code. Try again shortly.
phone.verifyFailed: That code didn't work. Try again.
phone.changedBody: Your new number is verified and now on your account.
phone.verifiedBody: Your phone number is now verified on your account.

errors.EMAIL_OR_PHONE_IN_USE: This is already registered to another account.
errors.EMAIL_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: Add a password under Sign-in and security first, then you can change your email.
errors.INVALID_PHONE_NUMBER: Enter a valid UK mobile number (07… or +44…).
errors.PHONE_VERIFICATION_RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in about an hour.
errors.TWILIO_VERIFY_NOT_CONFIGURED: Phone verification is unavailable right now. Try again later.
errors.PHONE_VERIFICATION_FAILED: Couldn't send or check your code. Try again shortly.
errors.PHONE_CHANGE_REQUIRES_VERIFICATION: To change a verified number, confirm the new one with the code we text you.
errors.INVALID_VERIFICATION_CODE: Enter the 6-digit code from your SMS.
errors.INVALID_OR_EXPIRED_VERIFICATION: That code is wrong or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.REAUTH_REQUIRED: For your security, sign out and sign in again, then change your number within 10 minutes.

email.title: 驗證你的電郵
email.body: 我們會傳送驗證連結到 {email}。打開收件匣中的連結，即可在帳戶上確認這個地址。這只證明聯絡方式屬於你，並非身份或安全審查。
email.sent: 驗證電郵已傳送，請查看你的收件匣。
email.tooSoon: 請等候 2 分鐘再重新傳送。
email.failed: 無法傳送驗證電郵，請稍後再試。

change.title: 更改電郵
change.body: 我們會傳送連結到你的新地址。在你打開連結前，{email} 仍會保留在帳戶上，我們亦會通知這個地址有關更改。
change.invalidEmail: 請輸入有效的電郵地址。
change.sentBody: 我們已傳送連結到 {email}。打開連結後，你的電郵便會更改。
change.failed: 無法開始更改電郵，請再試一次。

phone.introAdd: 輸入你的聯絡電話。我們只確認可以聯絡這個號碼，並非身份、DBS 或安全審查。
phone.introChange: 輸入你的新手提電話號碼。在你以短訊驗證碼確認新號碼前，現有號碼仍會保留在帳戶上。
phone.ukOnly: 只接受英國手提電話號碼（+44）。我們會以短訊傳送 6 位數驗證碼，以確認帳戶上的號碼。
phone.passwordHelp: 請輸入你的 Slashie 密碼以確認是你本人。我們亦會以短訊通知你現有的號碼。
phone.codeIntro: 請輸入我們傳送到 {phone} 的 6 位數驗證碼，以驗證這個手提電話號碼。
phone.codeHelp: 驗證碼 10 分鐘內有效。沒有收到？
phone.needPhone: 請輸入你的手提電話號碼。
phone.invalidPhone: 請輸入有效的英國手提電話號碼（+44）。
phone.samePhone: 這已經是你已驗證的號碼。
phone.needCode: 請輸入短訊中的 6 位數驗證碼。
phone.sendFailed: 無法傳送驗證碼，請稍後再試。
phone.verifyFailed: 驗證碼無效，請再試一次。
phone.changedBody: 你的新號碼已驗證，現已加入帳戶。
phone.verifiedBody: 你帳戶上的電話號碼現已驗證。

errors.INVALID_EMAIL: 請輸入有效的電郵地址。
errors.EMAIL_OR_PHONE_IN_USE: 這已登記在另一個帳戶。
errors.EMAIL_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: 請先在「登入與安全」加入密碼，然後便可更改電郵。
errors.RESEND_VERIFICATION_RATE_LIMITED: 請等候 2 分鐘再重新傳送。
errors.INVALID_PHONE_NUMBER: 請輸入有效的英國手提電話號碼（07… 或 +44…）。
errors.PHONE_VERIFICATION_RATE_LIMITED: 嘗試次數過多，請約一小時後再試。
errors.TWILIO_VERIFY_NOT_CONFIGURED: 電話驗證暫時無法使用，請稍後再試。
errors.PHONE_VERIFICATION_FAILED: 無法傳送或核對你的驗證碼，請稍後再試。
errors.PHONE_CHANGE_REQUIRES_VERIFICATION: 要更改已驗證的號碼，請以我們傳送的短訊驗證碼確認新號碼。
errors.INVALID_VERIFICATION_CODE: 請輸入短訊中的 6 位數驗證碼。
errors.INVALID_OR_EXPIRED_VERIFICATION: 驗證碼錯誤或已過期，請重新索取。
errors.REAUTH_REQUIRED: 為了你的帳戶安全，請登出後重新登入，然後在 10 分鐘內更改號碼。
